'''''Leucadendron laureolum''''', [[common name]]s '''golden conebush''' and '''laurel leaf conebush''', is a species of [[plant]] in the family [[Proteaceae]].<ref name=PlantzAfrica/> It is [[endemic]] to the southwestern [[Cape Provinces]] of [[South Africa]],<ref name = powo>[https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:704840-1 ''Leucadendron laureolum'' (Lam.) Fourc.] ''[[Plants of the World Online]]''. Retrieved 24 September 2023.</ref> and also cultivated. It is a large bush that turns bright yellow in the winter flowering season.<ref name=PlantzAfrica>{{citation |url=http://www.plantzafrica.com/plantklm/leucadenlaureolum.htm |title=PlantZAfrica.com |publisher=South African National Biodiversity Institute |access-date=27 December 2016}}</ref>
